answer: That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. The grove counter is kept in onyx and velvet makes public each threshold crossing. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
